item.text: {"question_id":"8B.6","answer":"In 2023, legislation, budgets, and directives became observable government practice across several domains, but conversion into reliable, nationwide delivery was uneven. The Bürgergeld Act, Wohngeld-Plus, care-support reform, the Supply Chain Act, smart-meter legislation, heat-planning law, electoral reform, and federal police-recording requirements entered legal or administrative practice (BATCH-0026-E007; BATCH-0024-E008; BATCH-0027-E014; BATCH-0008-E009; BATCH-0009-E003; BATCH-0009-E010; BATCH-0034-R05-E001; BATCH-0008-E003). BAföG produced measurable 2023 delivery: 635,600 recipients, €3.4 billion in expenditure, and higher average support, although fully funded school pupils declined (BATCH-0020-E007). The family-housing programme launched, was revised, received up to €350 million in 2023, and imposed eligibility and energy-efficiency requirements, but uptake, completed homes, and compliance were not shown (BATCH-0027-E003; BATCH-0027-E005). Resettlement also produced 4,614 admissions against 6,500 pledged places, with some entrants expected in 2024 (BATCH-0011-R01-E014). Federal online-service delivery was more concrete than the draft indicated: the government reported 97 of 115 federal services online, but most Länder and municipal services were not available nationwide; independent experts separately found the broader OZG target substantially missed, with only 105 of 575 services online at the earlier benchmark and continuing deficiencies in standards, timelines, monitoring, and implementation capacity (BATCH-0029-E001; BATCH-0009-E012). The record therefore shows real enactment, funding, administration, enforcement, and service delivery, not merely slogans, but substantial gaps remained. Independent or adverse evidence records delayed projects and parliamentary decisions, inadequate staffing for funding applications, delayed and underfunded independent asylum counselling, a stalled child-basic-income design, and severe delays in the Afghan admission programme: 229 selected by June but only 13 admitted by October after a pause and added screening (BATCH-0003-E009; BATCH-0003-E011; BATCH-0011-R03-E011; BATCH-0005-E006; BATCH-0011-R03-E013). Energy relief, LNG infrastructure, and Ukraine assistance indicate substantial activity, including delivered weapons, but some claims are official self-report or commitments and do not independently establish end-use, distribution, service quality, or outcomes (BATCH-0016-E018; BATCH-0029-E002; BATCH-0026-E004). Overall, implementation was real and broad but materially incomplete, with federal, Länder, municipal, ministerial, and subordinate implementation limiting personal Scholz
